systems.selected_s4_topology: autonomous native evolver over persistent harness state
autonomous base path using durable skill installation; parent path not selected for the candidate cell

gates.finding: Both canonical assessments are included and independently establish the selected S4 ownership states at their pinned review revisions.

A skills-only persistent target is structurally available on both pinned systems: A-Evolve exposes skills as an evolvable workspace layer, while Exo installs durable skills as agent artifacts consumed by later turns.
A-Evolve pins the public SkillsBench repository to revision 828bb921fb94dc065bfefd6bac4e8938be3f71e0 and exposes task/evaluator integration through its benchmark adapter.

The pinned built-in A-Evolve SkillsBench native solver constructs a Strands Agent backed by BedrockModel; its Harbor path uses a separate Vertex-style model binding. Pinned Exo supports OpenAI/OpenRouter and native Anthropic bindings, and explicitly excludes provider-prefixed Bedrock/Vertex Anthropic IDs from its native Anthropic route. The reviewed built-in routes therefore do not establish one exact common model/provider cell.
gates.blocking_effect: Do not execute or compare the candidate cell until an adapter-preserved common model/provider route is established by primary evidence.

gates.finding: A task/evaluator adapter for Exo is not promoted to an admissible matched runtime while the exact common model/provider gate is blocked. Structural feasibility is insufficient to count this gate as satisfied.
The protocol declares a skills-only ordinary-S4 target and protected regulator surfaces, but byte/hash stability has not been exercised in a valid common runtime and therefore remains unevaluated.
Both systems have persistent skill mechanisms, but the matched B0/A/H/R execution proving held-out future use has not run and cannot be credited while the provider gate is blocked.

excluded_substitution.reason: Pinned KADATH requires its native Architect to generate and lock the run benchmark from the goal and explicitly forbids dependence on a user-authored benchmark file or script; adapter preservation for an externally authored SkillsBench contract is not established.

non_claim: This preflight records a blocked built-in route. It is not a benchmark result, not a capability score, not evidence that either system lacks S4 capability, and not a basis for a cross-harness ranking.
